title: Asbestos.
officialText:
Prior to the commencement of demolition operations, all asbestos shall be removed from the area
authorized to be demolished by the department work permit, and certification to that effect shall be filed with the department
and the Department of Environmental Protection. Such asbestos removal shall be in accordance with Section 28-106 of the
Administrative Code and rules promulgated by the commissioner of the Department of Environmental Protection.
